name: Test Simple Activity
description: A deliberately simple activity to test the self-healing workflow

tasks.description: Create a simple JSON file with some data

prompt.template:
Create a file called {{outputFile}} with the following JSON content:

```json
{
  "message": "Hello from test activity",
  "timestamp": "{{timestamp}}",
  "status": "success"
}
```

Make sure the file is created in the current working directory.

variables.name: outputFile
variables.description: Name of the output file to create

variables.name: timestamp
variables.description: Timestamp to include in the file

tasks.description: Verify the file was created correctly

prompt.template:
Read the file {{outputFile}} and verify it contains:
1. A 'message' field
2. A 'timestamp' field
3. A 'status' field set to 'success'

If all checks pass, create a verification report in VERIFICATION.md with the results.
